newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian president Berisha resigns - radio.
newsitem.headline: Albanian president Berisha resigns - radio.

text.p: Albanian President Sali Berisha tendered his resignation on Wednesday, state Radio Tirana reported, shortly before the first meeting of the new parliament dominated by his Socialist opponents.

"I declare today my irrevocable resignation from the post of head of state to continue political parliamentary life supporting the values and the alternative I believe in," the radio quoted a statement from Berisha as saying.

There was no immediate confirmation from the presidency. But Berisha had been widely expected to resign so that he could take up a seat as a deputy for the opposition Democratic Party in the new parliament, which was to meet at 5 p.m. (1500 GMT).

The Democrats suffered a resounding defeat in June 29 elections called to end widespread and anarchy which followed the collapse of high-interest pyramid investment schemes in the impoverished Balkan country.
Berisha was expected to be replaced as president by Socialist Party secretary general Rexhep Mejdani.
